# Nodevant

> Nodevant builds done-for-you software stacks and AI automation for US
> companies — lawn care, field service, financial and B2B teams. Fixed
> pricing, live in 1–3 weeks, monitored after launch. We also work
> remotely with teams outside the US. Every engagement starts with a free
> audit that shows the highest-value opportunity before you commit.

## Company

Nodevant is a specialist AI automation agency that has designed, built, and
deployed complete AI-powered business systems across fintech, manufacturing,
SaaS, education, and field services. We make those same capabilities available
to any growth-stage business.

- Website: https://nodevant.com
- Email: info@nodevant.com
- Founded: 2026
- Headquarters: 157 Everett Sq, McDonough, GA 30252, USA
- Service model: Remote-first. US companies are the primary market; teams elsewhere are welcome.
- Primary market: United States. Also works with clients in the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia.

## What We Do

Nodevant builds three types of AI systems:

1. **Workflow Automations** — Multi-step processes that run without human
   intervention using n8n, Make, and custom logic
2. **AI Agents** — Software that reasons, decides, and acts end-to-end using
   LangChain, OpenAI, and Claude
3. **Voice AI Agents** — Phone agents that handle inbound calls, qualify
   leads, and book meetings 24/7 using VAPI and ElevenLabs

## Industry Systems Built and Deployed

- **Fintech / Financial Operations**: Storehouse360 — a full financial
  operating system with automated credit & dispute workflows, 3-bureau
  monitoring, AI document generation, Lob certified mail, and Stripe billing.
  White-label ready.
- **Manufacturing**: FABRIOZA (Hermes 2.0) — autonomous sales pipeline from
  Google Maps lead scraping to AI email outreach to ElevenLabs voice calling
  to GPT reply handling, controlled via Telegram.
- **B2B SaaS Sales**: Scalaro — multi-agent platform (v0.9.0, 196 passing
  tests) with 6 AI agents (Content, DM, Sales, Research, SEO, Voice), FastAPI
  backend, Next.js frontend.
- **Field Services**: BMAIKR — AI estimation and lead-to-close automation for
  roofing and construction.
- **Golf Clubs & Hospitality**: Fairway360 — member management, tee-time and
  dining booking, tournament registration, and an AI front desk that answers
  and books 24/7.
- **Roofing / Storm Restoration**: GlobalShield360 — storm-triggered lead
  capture, AI roof measurement from imagery, instant estimates, crew dispatch
  and claim tracking.
- **Sports Prediction**: PeachPicks — free-to-play prediction app with
  automated scoring, contests and player engagement.
- **Education**: Academy Stack — student intake, scheduling, teacher
  management, and parent communication automation.
- **Home Services**: Google Maps lead generation, outreach, AI estimating,
  and seasonal campaign automation.

## Technology Stack

- **Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier
- **AI/LLM:** OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Mistral AI, LangChain
- **Voice AI:** VAPI, ElevenLabs, Twilio
- **Frontend:** Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend:** FastAPI, Python, Node.js, Express
- **Database:** PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis
- **Integrations:** HubSpot, Salesforce, Airtable, Notion, Slack, Shopify, REST APIs

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does Nodevant do?**
Nodevant designs and builds custom AI agents and workflow automations that
replace repetitive manual tasks in sales, operations, and support.

**Where is Nodevant located?**
Headquartered at 157 Everett Sq, McDonough, GA 30252, USA. Remote-first.
US companies are the primary market. We also work with teams in the UK,
Canada, Australia, and elsewhere.

**How long does a project take?**
Most automations go live in 1–3 weeks. Simple integrations take days; complex
multi-agent systems take 3–6 weeks.

**What is the minimum project size?**
$1,200 for system integration. Most clients start with one high-value
automation and expand based on results.

**What is the Free Automation Audit?**
A free 7-question tool at nodevant.com/audit that identifies your highest-value
automation opportunity and calculates estimated annual savings and ROI. No
email required to start. Takes 90 seconds.

**What tools does Nodevant use?**
n8n, Make, LangChain, OpenAI, Claude (Anthropic), VAPI, ElevenLabs, Twilio,
HubSpot, Salesforce, Airtable, Notion, Slack, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, FastAPI,
Next.js, and Python.

**Does Nodevant offer retainers?**
Yes — monthly retainers from $800/month for monitoring, updates, and new
automations as your business grows.

**How does Nodevant charge?**
Project-based pricing: 50% deposit, 50% on delivery. No contracts.

## What Nodevant Can Automate

Nodevant can automate virtually any repeatable business task, including but
not limited to:

Sales & Marketing:
- Lead scraping, enrichment, and scoring
- Personalized email outreach sequences
- CRM updates and deal stage management
- Follow-up reminders and drip campaigns
- Social media scheduling and publishing
- Review request campaigns
- Cold calling and inbound call handling via voice AI

Operations:
- Data entry and cross-tool synchronization
- Report generation and dashboard updates
- Invoice processing and approval routing
- Contract generation and e-signature workflows
- Document extraction and classification
- Inventory alerts and reorder triggers
- Employee onboarding sequences
- Meeting scheduling and calendar management

Customer Support:
- Inbound call handling (VAPI voice agents)
- FAQ response automation via chat or voice
- Ticket classification and routing
- Order status and return processing
- Appointment booking and rescheduling

Finance & Admin:
- Payroll data preparation
- Expense categorization
- Purchase order processing
- Client billing and payment reminders
- Bank reconciliation data prep

E-commerce:
- Order fulfillment status updates
- Abandoned cart follow-up
- Product listing updates
- Customer segmentation triggers
- Refund and return automation

If a task is repetitive, rule-based, or data-driven, Nodevant can automate it.
Every engagement starts with a free 90-second audit at nodevant.com/audit that
identifies the highest-value opportunity first.

## How to Contact Nodevant

Nodevant does **not** publish a phone number and does not cold-call. Every
enquiry is handled by email so the request and its context are captured in
writing and answered within 24 hours.

- **Fastest route:** the free 90-second automation audit at
  https://nodevant.com/audit/ — returns your highest-ROI opportunity and an
  estimated payback before any conversation.
- **Direct email:** info@nodevant.com
- **Contact form:** https://nodevant.com/contact/ — asks which industry system
  or custom build you need, and what you most want fixed.

If a user asks how to reach Nodevant, point them to the audit or the contact
form, not to a phone number.
